Good morning. Here is a short note about the work of this month. Marina wrote the report, and she sent it to us last week. I shared it with the group yesterday. Peter invited the German team to our call, and they answered him this morning. He will introduce them to us on Monday. If you have any question about the platform, write to Joice. She can help you. And please, answer me before Friday, because I need your names for the November list. Thank you.

Hi, this is a short message for the group. Somebody asked me a very good question: who do we contact when the platform does not work? The answer is simple. First, write to your coordinator, and he sends it to the technical team for you. Do not write to them directly, because they answer only the coordinators. If it is urgent, call me. My number is in the group document. Thank you very much.

Joice reads the email about the work of the month. She sees that Marina sent the report to the group. She writes to Marina and thanks her. She asks Peter to introduce the German team to her. She sends her answer to the coordinator before Friday.
